title: AWS Step Functions Execution Failures

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:cloudwatch` events with `namespace="AWS/States" metric_name="ExecutionsFailed"` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.5.11 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudwatch` traffic without `namespace="AWS/States" metric_name="ExecutionsFailed"`. Confirm UC-4.5.11 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cloudwatch` collected via `Splunk_TA_aws`; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch" namespace="AWS/States" metric_name="ExecutionsFailed"
| table _time metric_name namespace unit average maximum
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.5.11_aws_step_functions_execu_11"
| sort -_time
description: UC-4.5.11 — AWS Step Functions Execution Failures: queries AWS `aws:cloudwatch` for search criteria `namespace="AWS/States" metric_name="ExecutionsFailed"` and returns actor, resource, and region context for availability review and change validation.
value: On AWS, detecting 'AWS Step Functions Execution Failures' early shortens cloud incident response and produces defensible audit evidence for identity and change-management controls. UC-4.5.11 drives high-priority availability alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Enable CloudWatch metrics for Step Functions (`ExecutionsFailed`, `ExecutionsTimedOut`, `ExecutionsAborted`). Ingest via Splunk_TA_aws. Optionally join with execution history forwarded to S3 or CloudWatch Logs for failure context. Alert on any failed executions in production state machines or rate-based thresholds.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_aws` with the modular input for `aws:cloudwatch`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.5.16.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `metric_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable CloudWatch metrics for Step Functions (`ExecutionsFailed`, `ExecutionsTimedOut`, `ExecutionsAborted`). Ingest via Splunk_TA_aws. Optionally join with execution history forwarded to S3 or CloudWatch Logs for failure context. Alert on any failed executions in production state machines or rate-based thresholds.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch" namespace="AWS/States" metric_name="ExecutionsFailed"
| table _time metric_name namespace unit average maximum
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.5.11_aws_step_functions_execu_11"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudwatch` in `index=aws` to detect aws step functions execution failures. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Amazon CloudWatch console Metrics for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `metric_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_5_11_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (failed executions by state machine), Single value (failures in last hour), Table (StateMachineArn, failed, timed out)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_aws` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of aws step functions execution failures so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
